sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's energy transition is accelerating via captive solar PPAs and EV fleet mandates, insulating local climate-tech from global rate volatility.
US utility exposure (PCG, SRE, EIX) remains hostage to wildfire liabilities and data-center demand, creating selective alpha for investors with risk appetite.
Carbon-credit monetization and biomass co-firing are emerging as durable revenue streams for Indonesian renewables, boosting project IRRs beyond tariff-only models.
sectors.ai: Buy the dip in Indonesian renewables names (LAPD, VKTR, KEEN) as local outperformance (+0.51%) against US weakness signals domestic policy tailwinds; ARKO's +13.46% confirms M&A-driven re-rating. Focus on grid-linked solar and EV charging plays, but trim US utilities (PCG, SRE) until rate-cut clarity returns.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG

Domestic staples face structural margin pressure from input cost inflation and weak purchasing power, favoring exporters and niche players with pricing power over mass-market names.
sectors.ai: Buy selective FMCG names with strong volume growth and margin expansion, as aggregate weakness masks robust single-stock momentum (BEEF, AGAR, TFCO). Favor exporters and raw-material beneficiaries over domestic staples; avoid laggards until IDX liquidity improves. Position for Q3 earnings beats in beef and agar-agar subsegments.
